title: Ge–Li–Lu–Zhou factor-two constrained commutator conjecture
statement:
Let $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{C}$, and let $B,B_2,\ldots,B_m\in M(n,\mathbb{K})$. Let $B^*$ denote the conjugate transpose and let $[A,B]=AB-BA$. Assume

$$
\operatorname{tr}(B_\alpha B_\beta^*)=0
$$

for every $2\leq\alpha\ne\beta\leq m$. **Ge–Li–Lu–Zhou conjecture.** Then

$$
\sum_{\alpha=2}^{m}\|[B,B_\alpha]\|^2\leq\left(2\max_{2\leq\alpha\leq m}\|B_\alpha\|^2+\sum_{\alpha=2}^{m}\|B_\alpha\|^2\right)\|B\|^2.
$$

The source describes this as another equivalent form of the fundamental Lu–Wenzel conjecture, apparently stronger in appearance but with a factor of $2$ in the bound; no resolution status is supplied.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01085

Status: **open** according to the source (as of February 2024). “They started with the following Conjectures , , and an open Question in the space $M(n, \mathbb{K})$ of $n\times n$ matrices over the field $\mathbb{K}=\mathbb{R}$.”
source_name: Jianquan Ge, Fagui Li, Zizhou Tang and Yi Zhou, “A survey on the DDVV-type inequalities”, arXiv:2402.01085 (2024).
